issues.quote: modes cannot enter both deterministic template mu(theta) and excess covariance Sigma(theta).
issues.analysis: A single Gaussian density N(mu(theta),C(theta)) can validly have both a deterministic mean and a stochastic covariance on identical modes. Counting the same data through two independent likelihood factors would double count; simultaneously modeling mean and covariance in one density does not. The guard imposes an unnecessary ell partition2-4 versus5-6 and drops deterministic high-mode information.
issues.minimal_fix: Enforce single density/unique data provenance rather than disjoint mean-covariance supports. Require justified covariance response and include one logdet. The artificial current covariance coefficient1e-8 should not be promoted as physics.

issues.analysis: N=300 simulation pairs estimate a p=135 covariance that is then treated as known. Under independent Gaussian/Wishart assumptions inverse sample covariance has inflation(N-1)/(N-p-2)=299/163=1.8343558282; the actual mask/map ensemble needs matched validation. Diagonal jitter does not account for covariance uncertainty. This may contribute to poor CMB chi2 but is not established as its sole cause.
issues.minimal_fix: Use a covariance-uncertainty likelihood or justified shrinkage/compression with heldout calibration and documented assumptions; retain same source/mask/pipeline and verify null coverage.
